entities.summary: The Evangelical Baptist Union of Ukraine or All-Ukrainian Union of Churches of Evangelical Christian Baptists (AUC ECB) (Ukrainian: Всеукраїнський союз церков євангельських християн-баптистів (ВСЦ ЄХБ), romanized: Vseukrainskyi soiuz tserkov yevanhelskykh khrystyian-baptystiv (VSTs YeKhB)) is a Baptist Christian denomination in Ukraine. It is affiliated with the Baptist World Alliance. The headquarters is in Kyiv. All-Ukrainian Union of Churches of Evangelical Christians-Baptists is a religious organization in Europe, established in 1990-01-27. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
